run.contact_l: left foot initial contact; right leg trailing; left begins support
run.down_l: left stance loading; pelvis lowers; right leg swings forward
run.passing_l: left foot supports; right swing foot passes the left support leg
run.flight_l: flight after left toe-off; right leg leads; neither foot supports
run.contact_r: right foot initial contact; left leg trailing; right begins support
run.down_r: right stance loading; pelvis lowers; left leg swings forward
run.passing_r: right foot supports; left swing foot passes the right support leg
run.flight_r: flight after right toe-off; left leg leads; neither foot supports

walk.contact_l: left foot initial contact; right leg trailing; left begins support
walk.down_l: left stance loading with brief double support; right toe leaves ground
walk.passing_l: left foot supports; right swing foot passes the left support leg
walk.up_l: left terminal stance; body rises; right leg leads toward contact
walk.contact_r: right foot initial contact; left leg trailing; right begins support
walk.down_r: right stance loading with brief double support; left toe leaves ground
walk.passing_r: right foot supports; left swing foot passes the right support leg
walk.up_r: right terminal stance; body rises; left leg leads toward contact
